name: runtime-declaration-applicability
goal: Require runtime profiling for actual executable initialization while exempting parsed ambient and type declarations; unreadable and mixed source remain required.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Actual SourceIndex probe: type exports mask a side-effect import and a module call; ambient declare-global plus export-empty incorrectly requires runtime profiling. Saved probe shows all three classification mismatches.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Extend standardized performance-evidence matrix with actual indexed source. Existing type-only case mutates exports metadata, so it misses top-level execution and ambient declarations. Keep CSS, unreadable, mixed, callable and fixture-boundary guards.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed d0910a9c8; sealed red dcae9e64a5ca preserves 8 actual failures and12passing controls from the unchanged20-case parsed-source matrix.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Record conservative AST-derived execution facts in SourceIndex metadata. Exempt only parsed declarations and readable stylesheets; runtime imports, statements, enums, malformed, unreadable and unknown source remain required. No extension-based exemption or fabricated profile.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Committed cff7a3382 adds conservative parsed execution facts and consumes them in mandatory performance validation. SourceIndex remains217lines; unchanged matrix20cases, unit-index11cases, task-audit4cases, types, lint and audit pass.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Sealed green9d4a219b937c at cff7a3382 pairs with red dcae9e64a5ca at d0910a9c8. Same20-case matrix, corpus, command and API process;52actual Harness measurements retained.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Clean snapshot replay of original classifier rejects8cases; repaired snapshot passesall20 unchangedcases. Type imports, ambient declarations, runtime initialization/imports/enums, malformedsource and unreadability are covered; CSS/mixed and fixture guards retained.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
